up: List all compounds from document CHEMBL5729714. For each compound, return its ChEMBL ID, name (pref_name), and canonical SMILES.
sql:
SELECT
  md.chembl_id,
  md.pref_name,
  cs.canonical_smiles
FROM docs d
JOIN compound_records cr ON d.doc_id = cr.doc_id
JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON cr.molregno = md.molregno
JOIN compound_structures cs ON md.molregno = cs.molregno
WHERE d.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL5729714';
